capabilities: Capture text, tags, recordings and images
Review old records via Daily Reunion
disambiguation: Despite its name, it does not sync with the flomo app; it captures text, recordings and images into local yearly Markdown notes.
extras: Transcription requires the user's own Tencent Cloud account and is billed to them; credentials are stored in device SecretStorage and must be set separately on each device. The plugin id changed from obsidian-flomo in v1.4.0, with a data.json migration step.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in one-key way to capture text, voice recordings and images into organized, dated notes.

relations.evidence: recordings are uploaded to Tencent Cloud and billed by your account

requires.name: Tencent Cloud account with flash recording-file recognition enabled
Tencent Cloud AppID, SecretId and SecretKey

summary: Quick capture plugin that saves text, tags, recordings and images into yearly Markdown notes, with Tencent Cloud transcription and note counts.
